rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a bracelet worn as wrist jewelry.

example.english: This bracelet is beautiful, and I wear it when I go for dim sum.
example.traditional: 呢隻鐲好靚，我戴住佢去飲茶。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 zuk1 hou2 leng3 ngo5 daai3 zyu6 keoi5 heoi3 jam2 caa4

rows.note: Use this specifically for the strap of a wristwatch rather than jewelry worn on its own.

example.english: The bracelet strap on my watch broke, so I need a new one.
example.traditional: 我隻錶嘅錶帶爛咗，要換條新嘅。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 biu1 ge3 biu1 daai3 laan6 zo2 jiu3 wun6 tiu4 san1 ge3
